newsitem.title: USA: Top U.S. general to visit Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Top U.S. general to visit Moscow.

text.p: U.S. Army Gen. John Shalikashvili, the U.S. military's top officer, will visit Moscow on Tuesday for talks with his Russian counterpart, the Defence Department said on Monday.

The Pentagon said Shalikashvili, the chairman of the U.S. Joint Chiefs of Staff, would depart Washington later on Monday and would hold a press availability with Chief of the General Staff Gen. Viktor Nikolayevich Samsonov at the Russian Defence Ministry on Tuesday.
Shalikashvili will also hold a press conference at the U.S. Embassy in Moscow on Tuesday afternoon before flying home to Washington.
